name: GPT-4.1 mini
description: Compact version of GPT-4.1 optimized for speed and cost efficiency.
longDescription: GPT-4.1 mini is a smaller, faster variant of GPT-4.1 designed for cost-effective production use. It retains the improved instruction following and coding capabilities of GPT-4.1 while being significantly cheaper and faster.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4.1-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
